title.zh: OpenAI 28天产品冲刺Day18：连发多项更新，最后还是又送了一次Reset
title.en: OpenAI 28天产品冲刺Day18：连发多项更新，最后还是又送了一次Reset

current_state.zh: OpenAI's Day 18 product sprint shipped the Decisions API as GA, donated the Open Responses cross-model API specification to the Linux Foundation's Agentic AI Foundation, added performance optimizations, and saw Uber expand ChatGPT Work from a 1,000-person pilot to over 30,000 employees, alongside another rate-limit reset.
